summary: Iteration 3 - full validation of preloader, hero slideshow, brand colour (oxblood #58130E), header letter-roll + footer marquee, brochure lead-capture gate, mobile 390, and regression. Backend pytest suite: 15/15 pass (health, project-types, enquiries CRUD/auth, brochure PDF cached). Frontend Desktop (1920x1080): Preloader mounts on first visit (data-testid=preloader), shows 'SUVI · INTER...' wordmark letter-by-letter, brass progress line, counter reaches 100, then wipes out (~4s total); verified only when sessionStorage 'suvi-intro-seen' is cleared BEFORE any origin script runs (must register add_init_script prior to first navigation to origin). Hero slideshow: hero-slides row + hero-slide-0/1/2 present; clicking hero-slide-1 changes hero-slide-caption to '02 / Modular Kitchens · Oak cabinetry · stone worktop'; ~7.5s later auto-advances to '03 / Bedroom Interiors'. H1 text 'Interiors that feel like home.' Brand colour: hero-secondary-cta background-color = rgb(88,19,14); philosophy-section background = rgb(88,19,14); intro-section numeral '01' color = rgb(88,19,14). Header/Footer: header-logo contains 12 .wm-l letter spans (each letter duplicated for roll effect), footer-wordmark-loop has 8 spans / 4 'Suvi Interior' repeats with computed animation-name = 'marquee'. Brochure gate (/brochure, localStorage cleared): brochure-download-btn renders as <button data-unlocked=false>; clicking opens brochure-gate modal (gate-name-input, gate-phone-input, gate-submit-button, gate-close-button). Empty submit shows gate-error-name + gate-error-phone. Valid submit ('Test Lead', '+91 98765 43210') POSTs /api/enquiries -> 201, opens gate-success with gate-pdf-link href ending /api/brochure.pdf, calls window.open to same URL, sets localStorage 'suvi-brochure-lead'='1'. GET /api/enquiries with X-Admin-Key returns the new lead {name:'Test Lead', project_type:'Other', requirement:'Brochure download', source_page:'/brochure'}. After close, all three download buttons (brochure-download-btn, -bar, -bottom) become <a data-unlocked='true' href='.../api/brochure.pdf'>; state persists after page reload. Mobile 390x844: documentElement.scrollWidth = 375 on both / and /brochure (no horizontal overflow); hero-slides row (top=703, bottom=748) sits above sticky bar (top=783), no overlap; gate modal inputs and submit visible. Regression: /services, /projects, /about, /contact load cleanly; contact form submits (contact-name-input etc.) and contact-success renders. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Preloader visibility hinges on sessionStorage key 'suvi-intro-seen' computed at module load in /app/frontend/src/lib/intro.js. This is a one-line static const so it only runs on first script eval; automated tests must register add_init_script (to clear sessionStorage) BEFORE any navigation to the origin. In production this is fine, but consider exposing a query-param override (e.g. ?intro=1) so QA/marketing can reliably re-trigger the intro without DevTools.

LeadGate creates the enquiry synchronously before opening the PDF via window.open. Popup blockers can block this in some browsers; the gate-success view already exposes a direct <a data-testid=gate-pdf-link>, but consider making the primary CTA an <a target=_blank> after submit-success to guarantee no popup-blocker interception.

intro.js sets sessionStorage as a side-effect at module import; if the Preloader is ever unmounted before its own effect runs (e.g. a Suspense boundary re-mounts), showIntro would be false on the second mount even though the animation never actually played. Consider gating the write to inside the Preloader's useEffect so 'seen' only becomes true after the animation completes.
seed_data_creation: 1 Brochure lead enquiry ('Test Lead', +91 98765 43210, source_page=/brochure) plus 3 TEST_-prefixed contact enquiries created via pytest. Safe to purge (all names start with 'TEST_' or 'Test Lead').
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reliably trigger the Preloader in Playwright: start with page_url='about:blank', call page.add_init_script to clear sessionStorage/localStorage, THEN page.goto(BASE+'/'). If you navigate to the origin before registering the init_script, intro.js will have already set 'suvi-intro-seen'='1' and the preloader will not appear on subsequent goto's in the same context. Backend regression: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -p no:randomly -q` (~2s). Contact form uses testids contact-name-input / contact-phone-input / contact-email-input / contact-project-type-select (native <select>, use select_option label='Modular Kitchen') / contact-message-input / contact-submit-button -> contact-success.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects. Only environmental gotcha: preloader detection requires init-script-based sessionStorage reset BEFORE first navigation to origin.
